name: Girish D. Sakpal
highlight: I always like to solve problems which common people face daily. In an attempt to do so, I built apps like PlanAIr and WatchBoard. PlanAIr is an AI-based smart scheduler which respects your time and helps you plan better. WatchBoard is a personal board for the movies, TV shows, and anime you want to watch, and the ones you already have.Both are deployed and you can find them on my Github profile.
